item: a leftover -wal beside a file with no visible app_state is a failed settings read, not a first run; the machine record names the YAML loader
summary: kv_get_json_checked read 'no such table' as a first run. When the previous session left a non-empty <db>-wal, the table may only be unfolded, so a caller with a permissive default (the transport setting) took a failed read for nothing stored. It now raises KvReadError (class only) when a non-empty -wal sits beside the file; no retry, no read-write open, files untouched; no wal or an empty wal stays a first run. kv_get_json (the permissive reader) is unchanged. machine_record versions gains yaml_loader (CSafeLoader or SafeLoader, read without parsing, null if unreadable) inside the 10,000 B bound. Item 27 (lease heartbeat, R431) stays a proposal. Mutation-checked by the three wal tests; -shm is excluded from the byte compare because a reader maps it.
